blacklistabilityReview.evidence: KB's primary announcement confirms a closed issuance, payment, settlement and remittance proof of concept and law-dependent future services, but publishes no token contract, production holder policy or freeze authority. Kaia's overview describes bank deposit, KYC/AML and dual-signature compliance infrastructure generally; it does not prove that an exact KB token implements particular blacklist functions. The possible verdict records unresolved token-specific control scope rather than inferring a confirmed freeze capability from bank participation.
